name: Da Lat Market
kicker: Flower and produce halls above the lake
summary: The sloping halls above Xuan Huong Lake are the morning stop for strawberries, flowers, and avocado ice cream. Entry is free. Stall prices are Check on arrival. Plan about an hour, then walk back down to the water.
getThere: Walk uphill from Xuan Huong Lake
heroCaption: Night stalls on the market slope
body: Walk up from the lake into the sloping halls. Morning is produce, flowers, and a cup of strawberries with condensed milk. Avocado ice cream is the cold snack at the counters. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism puts those stalls with the central market.

Give the halls about an hour. The door is free. What you buy is Check on arrival, and so are the address and the hours. After dark the night market in the centre is a separate set of stalls. Visit Lâm Đồng puts those at about 18:00 to 23:00.

figures.caption: Morning produce in the market hall
figures.alt: Morning fruit and produce stalls inside Da Lat Market

gettingThere: The market sits on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake. Walk up from the shore. Visit Lâm Đồng does not print a street number. The address is Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: On foot, up the slope. The walk is short. A minute count is not printed. Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Entry is free. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism describes flowers and produce. Stall prices for fruit and snacks are Check on arrival. Visit Lâm Đồng does not print the street address or the opening hours.
